Off-Ice Hockey Training: The Complete Guide

The complete, science-based guide to off-ice and dryland training for hockey. What to train, how often, what gear you actually need, the most common mistakes, and how it changes from a nine-year-old to a forty-year-old, with a ready-built program for every age.

Speed is built off the ice. The three drivers of skating speed, the dryland work that develops each, and the exercises and weekly plan to put it together.

Common Off-Ice Training Mistakes to Avoid
Eight off-ice training mistakes that quietly hold hockey players back, from random workouts to skipping the warm-up, and the simple, science-based fix for each one.
